entries.wording: 已收件,收件网点【…】,扫描员是【…】
entries.note: Huaqi took the freight in at its branch; the adapter leaves out the scanner.

entries.wording: 离开【…】,发往【…】 or 快件离开【…】，已在发往【…】的路上
entries.note: Left a branch or hub for the next one.

entries.wording: 快件在【…】完成分拣，准备发往【…】
entries.note: Sorted at a hub of the partner network carrying the long-distance leg.
Reached a hub or the delivering store.

entries.wording: 快件开始长途运输… or 车辆正在长途运输中…
entries.note: On the long-distance truck; the row names a city it is near or the expected arrival.

entries.wording: 快件交给【…】，正在派送途中（…）
entries.note: Handed to the courier; the adapter leaves out the courier's name, phone and closing note.

entries.wording: 您的快件已派送至本人，如有疑问请电联快递员【…】…
entries.note: Delivered to the recipient; the adapter leaves out the courier and the courtesy text.
